about: What GET /api/graph sends per page for the Journal (lib/GraphModel.psm1, 2026-11-17): created = OneNote's own page date (the hierarchy's dateTime), entries = a journal day page's entries (obsn.entries), [] for every other page. Invented data. tests/Journal.Tests.ps1 builds these pages in the in-memory OneNote (obsn.id, obsn.type = kind, obsn.topics = topicIds, obsn.links = links, obsn.entries from entries, the page date = created) and asserts the produced pages equal this file; the interface's journal tests (ui-src/src/journal/journalModel.test.ts) build their model from the same pages and edges.
